story.title: How Do Simple Machines Help Us Do Work?
paragraphs_en: You might be wondering,what simple machines are!! Well,now when you go deep, reading the book,you will find out how simple machines look like and what simple machines are.
What are simple machines? Simple Machines help us do work by lifting,moving and cutting heavy things. How do simple machines look like? Well,can you see a picture? This picture is an inclined plane.
An example of an inclined plane is a slope or a ramp. There are more simple machines. Go to the next page look for more simple machines!!!
Now,can you see an axe in between the trunk? This is an example of the simple machine wedge! This simple machines helps in chopping a heavy thing.
Now,this is one of the simple machines. Can you guess what it is? Yes,it is a screw. A screw helps in turning the thing round and round.

Đúng rồi, đó là một cái đinh ốc.

sentences.text_en: A screw helps in turning the thing round and round.
sentences.text_vi: Cái đinh ốc giúp xoay vật đó vòng tròn.
